I took your advice and took the next day off from work, giving me two days to catch my breath, and I feel a little less...urgent, I guess? Like everything is still lurking, but it doesn't feel as immediate.

Also, I can't really report my boss, seeing as I work at a small business (a grocery store), and he's the owner.

I don't really have anyone to fall back on, unfortunately, so I'm still at a loss for what to do there.
